title: Staging MariaDB JSON path parameter contract for migration 125

phases.objective: Make the exact Staging schema replay reject invalid path_param_keys metadata during plan-only validation and apply migration 125 with a valid JSON array for the contribution_id route parameter in disposable MariaDB 11.4.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging schema bundle generator and disposable MariaDB 11.4
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact merged Staging checkout inventories the baseline and ordered migrations, validates catalog path parameter metadata, and applies migration 125 only inside a disposable local MariaDB 11.4 schema.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The migration chain passes static path_param_keys validation, migration 125 writes JSON_ARRAY('contribution_id') without ERROR 4025, and the schema-only bundle contract remains protected from Production, provider, credential, and data-export access.
steps: Load the canonical baseline and numerically ordered migration chain in plan-only mode.
Validate every direct path_param_keys INSERT writer as NULL, JSON_ARRAY(...), or a JSON array string before starting MariaDB.
Apply migration 125 in disposable MariaDB 11.4 and require the three non-empty schema-only role bundles plus manifest checks before considering replay successful.
Keep Production mutation, provider mutation, deployment, credential payload reads, and data export forbidden.
assertions: Migration 125 encodes contribution_id as a JSON array rather than a bare scalar string.
The builder static validator covers direct path_param_keys INSERT statements and fails closed on invalid JSON array metadata.
The builder regression and ordered pre-use plan pass across the complete migration chain before confirmed replay.
The confirmed replay uses only disposable local MariaDB 11.4 and preserves schema_only=true with all Production/provider/data/secrets safety flags false.
